_comment: src/config/severity-policy.json — S-09 deterministic severity policy + 04 D-07 app-profile escalation. Canonical: no check→nudge, check+irreversible→block, check+reversible→warn, unknown≠pass. Per FINAL-v2 §2 S-09 + 04 S-11/S-14 + deepseek decision tree.
_status: aspirational (Oct 26) — design policy, not runtime: no rule reads this file (comment mentions only); severities are hard-coded in src/rules/index.ts REGISTRY. Driving a rule from it is future work.
description: Deterministic function: every block has a command returning a verdict (S-05). Severity is policy from declared intent (.fence/app-profile.json local/shared/public → 14/29/55 blocks). AI-specific rules block even at local.

function._note: S-11/S-14 + deepseek §1/§6 — no deterministic check → nudge (never a gate); check+irreversible/high-blast → block (before action); check+reversible → warn (queue + fix-now-or-next-digest).

rules.note: Prose advice, not a guardrail — never a block (S-05: no deterministic check → never a block)

rules.condition: check exists + irreversible or high blast radius
rules.note: Fail closed before mutation — secrets, credential exfiltration, irreversible DB drops
Queue + fix-now-or-next-digest — lint, headers, non-critical hygiene

outcomes._note: Four-outcome model per gpt-6 implication 1 (ASVS 5.0.0) — unknown≠pass (S-05/S-09). Missing evidence is unknown, not pass.
outcomes.on_unknown: emit unknown with reason — never pass (preserve S-05 invariant)
outcomes.on_not_applicable: skip — rule does not apply to this project shape

app_profile._note: S-09 — severity derived from .fence/app-profile.json intent declaration (minimax §9.1). One-fact-one-location: user declares intent once, harness derives every rule's severity.
app_profile.ai_specific_note: AI-specific rules (agent identity, MCP pin, slopsquat, LLM-output sanitization) are block even at local — compromise vector is the agent, not the user (S-09)
app_profile.csp_discipline: Report-Only first; enforce when violations = 0 (S-09 / minimax A-15)
app_profile.secrets_discipline: warn until allowlist exists, then block (04 D-03 / minimax two-phase)
app_profile.devDependencies_heuristic: warn (not block) until triage pipeline lands — C-07a / GEM-05

examples._note: Illustrative — not exhaustive. Real rules live in .fence/rules/<id>.json per gpt-6 implication 1.
unknown: remote RLS check without network — run fence verify-remote when connected

suppression._note: Every block must have a documented suppression path with a reason string (04 D-03 / minimax §10).
suppression.mitigation_expiry: mitigations require rule + evidence + scope + owner + expiry/recheck; dep change invalidates stale decisions (gpt-6 implication 9)
